steps.title: Open the Cockpit
steps.narration: The Cockpit is the main trading dashboard. It shows live price data and tape activity for the symbol you're watching.
steps.point_out: The top bar with the ticker input and Watch button is visible, and no error message appears.

steps.title: Watch a ticker
steps.narration: Type a ticker symbol and click Watch to start seeing live price updates and recent trades on the chart.
steps.point_out: The price chart appears below the top bar and shows a candlestick graph. Live quote and tape data begin ticking.

steps.title: Click Watch to start
steps.narration: Click the Watch button to begin streaming live data.
steps.point_out: The chart and tape become active with real-time price and volume updates.

steps.title: Navigate to Structure
steps.narration: The Structure page shows the price bands and zones where trades tend to cluster. It helps you see support and resistance levels at a glance.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map panel is visible with band and zone data. No error message or unavailable state appears.

steps.title: Open Desk monitoring
steps.narration: The Desk page lets you see readiness metrics for live trading and review your recorded trading setups.
steps.point_out: The Playbook Signals panel and Backscan control are visible at the top. The page loads without errors.

steps.title: Expand Microscope Readiness section
steps.narration: The Microscope Readiness section at the bottom shows the health and coverage of your recorded tick data. Click its header to expand and see the corpus summary.
steps.point_out: The section expands to show a Corpus Totals table with five rows (Distinct symbol-days, Distinct datasets, RTH minutes covered, Session-equivalents, Referee tick-gate). No error state appears.
